QuestInfo.name: Isolation
QuestInfo.0: Chief Alex has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: Cygnus's attack cut off communication with the other towns. Go to Six Path Crossway and search for any open roads.
QuestInfo.2: The Six Path Crossway was destroyed and there was no way to travel to the other towns. What might have become of those regions?

0.0: It's good to see you. I have a new task for you.

yes.0: You're the first person from outside Henesys we've seen since the Cygnus attack. The monsters have us cut off from the Six Path Crossway, but you--you could make it! Please, go there now and see if you can contact the other towns.

no.0: I think this task is of particular interest to you...

1.0: The Crossway was destroyed? There must be some way to contact the other towns...

yes.0: I just hope we're not the only survivors. We need to gather our strength...
